data.title: Šurany in 3D – an animation of the castle for Museum Night
data.excerpt: This Saturday, for Museum Night, we will present at the museum in Šurany a complete 3D animation of Šurany and Šurany Castle as they looked in the 15th century. The video runs for over 8 minutes and is our best animation so far.

mediaTexts.alt: A 3D reconstruction of a moated castle with a bridge and a hamlet in marshland

children.text: This Saturday, at the museum in Šurany, we will present a complete 3D animation of Šurany and Šurany Castle as they looked in the 15th century, on the occasion of Museum Night. The video runs for over 8 minutes. It is our best animation so far. If you are not far away, do not miss it!
